messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Mi ne povas bone rakonti kiel mi eniris ĝin, tiel plena de dormemo mi estis tiutempe kie mi forlasis la veran vojon.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Io | 1st‑person singular pronoun, subject of “non so” | Mi | I | OK | | non | Negation particle (¬) | ne | not | OK | | so | Verb *sapere* “to know” (present, 1 sg) → ability negated | povas | can | OK | | ben | Manner adverb “well” | bone | well | OK | | ridir | Infinitive “to recount / tell again” | rakonti | to recount | OK | | com' | Interrogative adverb “how” | kiel | how | OK | | i' | Clitic pronoun “I” (subject of embedded clause) | mi | I | OK | | v'intrai | Past historic “entered (it)” | eniris | entered | OK | | tant' | Degree adverb “so, such” | tiel | so | OK | | era | Imperfect “was” (3 sg) | estis | was | OK | | pien | Predicative adjective “full” | plena | full | OK | | di | Preposition “of” | de | of | OK | | sonno | Noun “slumber, sleepiness” | dormemo | slumber | OK | | a | Temporal preposition “at” (introducing “quel punto”) | — (merged into *tiutempe*) | — | UNNECESSARY | | quel | Demonstrative adjective “that” | tiu | that | OK | | punto | Noun “point, moment” | tempo | point/time | OK | | che | Relative conjunction “where” | kie | where | OK | | la | Definite article (feminine) | la | the | OK | | verace | Adjective “true, correct” (feminine) | veran | true | OK | | via | Noun “way, path” (accusative) | vojon | way | OK | | abbandonai | Past historic “abandoned” | forlasis | abandoned | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *a* – the preposition “at” is not required in Esperanto because the temporal notion is expressed by the adverbial form *tiutempe* (“at that time”). No other words are missing, wrong, or grammatically mismatched.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
